content.text:
All three sizes are rendered and verified at exact dimensions, with no clipping, overflow, or overlap.

**Files written to the working folder:**
- `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master)
- `landscape.png` — 1920×1080
- `story.png` — 1080×1920
- `card.html` — the source template (`?size=square|landscape|story`)

**Design notes:**
- **Square:** logo lockup top-left, large keynote title centered in the body, portrait + name/role row, date and pill button on a baseline footer.
- **Landscape:** two-column split — title on the left, circular portrait with name/role stacked on the right (name tuned to 41px so it sits on one line), footer spanning full width.
- **Story:** fully centered vertical stack with evenly distributed whitespace and a full-width pill button at the bottom.

Shared: Inter loaded via `@font-face`, `#0F1226` background with violet radial glows, `#7C5CFF` accent on the kicker, the highlighted title phrase, the meta dot and the button. The portrait uses `border-radius:50%` + `object-fit:cover` so it stays a true circle at every size, with a violet ring. The title uses `text-wrap:balance` plus non-breaking hyphens in "Okonkwo‑Lindqvist" and "on‑call" to avoid awkward line breaks.
